title: Viwakilishi (Theme 2: Nidhamu mezani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child replaces a noun already named with the pronoun that matches its person and number.
representations: a person chart: mimi, wewe, yeye; sisi, nyinyi, wao
a short text with repeated names to replace
steps: Ask: one or many? me, you, or another?

board.do: Amina amefika. Amina ni rafiki yangu.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child rewrites the second sentence with "Yeye".

misconceptions.ask: Unaweza kutumia neno gani badala ya kurudia jina?
misconceptions.repair: Badala ya kurudia jina, tumia kiwakilishi: yeye, wao.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Juma na Otieno ni marafiki. ___ wanacheza pamoja." Kwa nini "Yeye" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Yeye" ni mtu mmoja. "Wao" ni watu wengi. Juma na Otieno ni wawili, kwa hiyo ni "wao".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mimi na wewe ni marafiki. ___ tunasoma pamoja." Kwa nini "Wao" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Sisi" ni mimi na wengine. "Wao" ni watu wengine, bila mimi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Angalia, ___ ni mwalimu wetu, ameketi karibu nami." Kwa nini "Yule" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Huyu" na "hawa" hutumika kwa walio karibu. "Yule" na "wale" hutumika kwa walio mbali.

checks.question: Jaza: Kitabu kile ni chako; ___ hapa ni changu.
